indexes.expression: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dashboard_items_dashboard_id_position_key ON public.dashboard_items USING btree (dashboard_id, "position")
CREATE INDEX idx_dashboard_items_order ON public.dashboard_items USING btree (dashboard_id, "position")
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dashboards_access_key_unique ON public.dashboards USING btree (access_key_hash) WHERE (access_key_hash IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX dashboards_slug_unique ON public.dashboards USING btree (lower(slug))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_incidents_heartbeat_open ON public.incidents USING btree (heartbeat_id) WHERE ((heartbeat_id IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'resolved'::text))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_notification_delivery_occurrence ON public.notification_deliveries USING btree (channel_id, event, occurrence_key) WHERE (occurrence_key IS NOT NULL)

indexes.expression: CREATE INDEX idx_sponsors_public ON public.sponsors USING btree (tier, display_order, lower(name)) WHERE (published_at IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX sponsors_name_unique ON public.sponsors USING btree (lower(name))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX status_pages_slug_unique ON public.status_pages USING btree (lower(slug))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_status_subscriber_delivery_occurrence ON public.status_subscriber_deliveries USING btree (subscriber_id, event, occurrence_key) WHERE (occurrence_key IS NOT NULL)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX teams_slug_unique ON public.teams USING btree (lower(slug))
CREATE INDEX idx_users_global_admin ON public.users USING btree (is_global_admin, disabled_at) WHERE (is_global_admin = true)
CREATE INDEX idx_users_last_signed_in ON public.users USING btree (last_signed_in_at DESC) WHERE (last_signed_in_at IS NOT NULL)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX users_email_unique ON public.users USING btree (lower(email))
